description: This Java source file defines a global exception handler class for a Spring-based backend application, mapping various exceptions to standardized JSON HTTP responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring controller advice class that handles exceptions globally and converts them into JSON error responses.

methods.name: notFound
methods.description: Handles NoSuchElementException and returns a 404 Not Found response with error details.

methods.name: badRequest
methods.description: Handles IllegalArgumentException and ConstraintViolationException, responding with a 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: validation
methods.description: Handles validation errors (MethodArgumentNotValidException) and returns detailed information about field errors.

methods.name: generic
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions, returning a 500 Internal Server Error response.
